The structure of Ce4Mn2 (reduced formula Ce2Mn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 10 neighbors (4 Ce, 6 Mn) and Mn centers with 10 neighbors (4 Ce, 6 Mn), both forming close-packed-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ce-centered 10-vertex polyhedra and between Mn-centered 10-vertex polyhedra.
